findings.title: stale-root gate stops firing for kernel consumers outside bin/libexec/runners (four engine adapters and scripts/beta-qualify.sh arm it and never fire it), and INV-15 section 4's glob shares the blind spot

runners/orchid-service fires the gate above the install arm's --interval-s validation, so a typo out of a stale root is answered with the checkout refusal — the opposite of the edge section 8 pins for orchid trust
orchid-doctor now runs the pre-merge trust library's full history walk and mktemp scratch before the stale-root refusal whose text asserts nothing was run
